name: RearmAddMultiRelease
description: Submit several ReARM releases in one all-or-nothing batch (rearm addreleases). The caller provides the complete batch JSON; the task derives nothing from the pipeline context.
helpMarkDown:
[Learn more about this task](https://github.com/relizaio/rearm-ado-extension)

Submits several ReARM releases in one all-or-nothing batch via `rearm addreleases`, so the backend fires product auto-integration once per affected feature set for the whole batch rather than once per release.

Provide the batch as inline `releases` JSON **or** point `infile` at a file on disk (if both are set, `infile` wins). Each element is shaped exactly like the single-release `addrelease` input (`ReleaseInputProg`) — `component` (or `vcsUri` + `repoPath`), `branch`, `version`, `lifecycle`, optional `sourceCodeEntry`, `outboundDeliverables`, `artifacts`, plus per-release flags such as `rebuildRelease` and `createComponentIfMissing`. Artifacts reference local files via their `filePath` field, resolved relative to `workingDirectory`; the CLI reads and uploads each file.

```json
[
  {
    "vcsUri": "github.com/acme/monorepo",
    "repoPath": "services/widget",
    "branch": "main",
    "version": "1.4.0",
    "lifecycle": "ASSEMBLED",
    "rebuildRelease": true,
    "sourceCodeEntry": { "commit": "9f1c2ab", "uri": "github.com/acme/monorepo", "type": "git" },
    "outboundDeliverables": [
      {
        "displayIdentifier": "registry.acme.com/widget:1.4.0",
        "type": "CONTAINER",
        "softwareMetadata": { "packageType": "CONTAINER", "digests": ["sha256:abc123"] },
        "artifacts": [
          { "displayIdentifier": "widget-image-sbom", "type": "BOM", "bomFormat": "CYCLONEDX", "filePath": "./services/widget/sbom.cdx.json" }
        ]
      }
    ]
  }
]
```

For the exact JSON shape, refer to the ReARM CLI documentation.
author: Reliza Incorporated

inputs.name: rearmApiKeyId
inputs.label: ReARM API Key ID
inputs.helpMarkDown: API Key ID for ReARM authentication

inputs.name: releases
inputs.label: Releases JSON
inputs.helpMarkDown: JSON array of release objects (ReleaseInputProg shape). Provide this OR 'infile'; if both are set, 'infile' wins. Artifacts reference local files via their 'filePath' field, resolved relative to 'workingDirectory'. See task documentation for the schema.

inputs.name: infile
inputs.label: Batch File Path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path (relative to 'workingDirectory', or absolute) to a JSON file containing the release array. Takes precedence over 'releases'. Use when an earlier step has already written the batch to disk.

inputs.name: stripbom
inputs.label: Strip BOM for Digest Matching
inputs.helpMarkDown: Uncheck to disable BOM stripping for digest matching; applied to every artifact in the batch.

inputs.name: workingDirectory
inputs.label: Working Directory
inputs.helpMarkDown: Process directory the CLI runs from — the base every artifact 'filePath' (and a relative 'infile') resolves against. NOT a per-release repo path; that is the 'repoPath' field inside each JSON element (paired with 'vcsUri'). Defaults to the pipeline workspace root.
